task.title: Remove or justify the no-op sync tracking-ref reset
task.description:
The projection refresh work added deleteTrackingTaskRefs to reset refs/workbook/remotes/ between local-bare sync samples, on the assumption that stale tracking refs would make a later sample's initial sync non-initial. That assumption was probed and found false: the product's fetch already uses --prune, so the helper is a no-op today.

It was retained as a defensive reset and its comment and documentation were corrected to say so rather than overclaim. Unreachable defensive code in a measurement harness is a liability, because it implies a guarantee that no test exercises.

The real property is instead asserted by TestMeasureLocalBareSyncPublishesEverySampleToItsOwnOrigin, which checks that each sample's origin ends up with exactly the canonical refs.

Either remove the helper and rely on that test, or add a test that exercises the condition the helper defends against so the code is reachable and justified.

Acceptance: internal/perf contains no unreachable defensive branch in the sync sampling path, or the branch is covered by a test that fails when the helper is removed.
